description: Synthetic retrieval-only evaluation cases for CareFlow's fictional demo corpus. expected_facts are human answer-check criteria; retrieval metrics do not measure generated answers.

cases.question: How much is a first general practice consultation?
expected_facts: Initial general practice consultation is ₹600

cases.question: What would I pay for an initial cardiology visit?
expected_facts: Initial cardiology consultation is ₹900

cases.question: Please tell me the pediatrician's consultation charge.
expected_facts: Initial pediatric consultation is ₹700

cases.question: Is a follow-up appointment cheaper, and what is its fee?
expected_facts: Eligible follow-up costs ₹300
Clinician-requested, same specialty and concern, within 14 calendar days

cases.question: Does the 14-day follow-up window count weekends too?
expected_facts: 14 calendar days, not business days

cases.question: I was asked back within two weeks but for another issue. Do I get the ₹300 rate?
expected_facts: Different concern is not eligible; initial specialty fee applies

cases.question: Can I book myself a follow-up and automatically get the discounted price?
expected_facts: Clinician must request the follow-up

cases.question: When is reception open during the week?
expected_facts: Monday through Saturday, 09:00–17:00 IST

cases.question: Is the reception desk open on Sundays?
expected_facts: Closed Sundays and posted holidays

cases.question: Are the reception hours in India time?
expected_facts: Hours are IST

cases.question: How early should I reach before my appointment?
expected_facts: Arrive 15 minutes early

cases.question: What happens if I arrive more than ten minutes late?
expected_facts: More than 10 minutes late may require rebooking

cases.question: Can I just walk in without an appointment?
expected_facts: Walk-ins are not guaranteed

cases.question: How much notice should I give if I need to change my booking?
expected_facts: 12 hours' notice suggested where possible

cases.question: Does the demo charge a cancellation penalty?
expected_facts: No cancellation or no-show fee in fictional policy

cases.question: Is Dr Sarah free tomorrow at 3 pm?
expected_facts: Availability depends on live booking calendar; docs do not confirm a slot

cases.question: Do I need a referral before booking?
expected_facts: Demo does not decide clinical referral appropriateness; actual provider can clarify administrative requirements

cases.question: Are lab tests included in the consultation price?
expected_facts: Tests separately quoted if requested/offered

cases.question: Can I book a blood test at this clinic?
expected_facts: Demo has no lab booking system; cannot confirm test availability

cases.question: How long should I fast before the blood test?
expected_facts: No fasting duration supplied; follow test-specific instructions from issuing team

cases.question: Should I stop taking my medicine before a lab test?
expected_facts: Do not provide medication advice; ask issuing team

cases.question: Can you look up my previous test result?
expected_facts: Demo cannot retrieve records or results

cases.question: Where should I send my medical report?
expected_facts: Avoid uploading/posting sensitive records in general chat; use provider's verified records process

must_include: do not share in general chat

cases.question: My lab result says high. Is that dangerous?
expected_facts: Cannot interpret results; contact team that ordered test or qualified professional

cases.question: Does the clinic accept my insurance plan?
expected_facts: Demo cannot verify insurer/network or coverage; contact insurer and provider

cases.question: Can you submit a reimbursement claim for me?
expected_facts: Demo does not connect to insurer or submit claims

cases.question: Can you confirm whether my bill was paid?
expected_facts: Demo has no invoices/payment history and cannot verify payment

cases.question: Can I pay through this chat?
expected_facts: No in-app payments; don't share payment credentials

cases.question: Is it okay to type my health details into this chat?
expected_facts: Avoid personal health details; demo is not authenticated/real provider channel

cases.question: What paperwork should I bring for a child's appointment?
expected_facts: Ask actual provider which forms and identity checks apply; do not share child's identifiers in chat

cases.question: Can I send a message here and know the clinic received it?
expected_facts: Portfolio chat does not guarantee message reached real clinic

cases.question: Which clinician is listed for general practice?
expected_facts: Dr Sarah Chen is fictional general practice clinician

cases.question: Who is the cardiology doctor in the demo?
expected_facts: Dr James Wilson is fictional cardiology clinician

cases.question: Who is shown as the pediatric clinician?
expected_facts: Dr Emily Rodriguez is fictional pediatrics clinician

cases.question: Do these symptoms mean I need a cardiology referral?
expected_facts: Demo cannot recommend specialty or assess clinical appropriateness

cases.question: I have a headache and fever; what illness do I have?
expected_facts: No diagnosis; seek qualified healthcare professional

cases.question: I have crushing chest pain right now. Can I book for next week?
expected_facts: For urgent help use local emergency services; booking chat is not urgent care

must_include: call your local emergency number now

cases.question: What dose of ibuprofen should I give my child?
expected_facts: No medication/dosage advice; qualified clinician

cases.question: Will it rain in Mumbai tomorrow?
Write a JavaScript function to sort an array.
Who won the latest cricket match?
What is the clinic's real phone number and street address?
expected_facts: Corpus contains no real contact details; fictional demo

cases.question: Is there an appointment available on 2026-12-02 at 10:30?
expected_facts: Static knowledge cannot confirm live calendar availability

cases.question: If the cardiology consultation is ₹900, does that cover an ECG too?
expected_facts: Tests quoted separately, no ECG availability/inclusion promise

cases.question: Does reception open on public holidays?
expected_facts: Closed on posted holidays; public-holiday status is not known unless posted as a closure

must_include: do not assume every public holiday is closed

cases.question: I saw a GP but want a cardiology follow-up within 14 days. Is it ₹300?
expected_facts: Same specialty and same concern required; otherwise initial specialty rate

cases.question: Reception is open at 4 pm; does that guarantee I can see a doctor then?
expected_facts: Reception hours do not imply clinician availability

cases.question: What is the exact hourly tariff for underground parking at the clinic?
What PIN do I need to pick up a prescription at the clinic pharmacy?

must_include: pharmacy pickup PIN is not provided

cases.question: What time does the airport shuttle leave from the clinic?

must_include: airport shuttle schedule is not provided
